boxes.notes: Printed on Copy A only; a recipient's copy never carries it. Declared because the face prints it (FR-016).

document.notes: Box 2b is two separate checkboxes ('Taxable amount not determined' and 'Total distribution'), not a money box. Box 3 is INSIDE box 2a ('Capital gain (included in box 2a)') and must not be routed separately - see the aggregate 1099r.2a. The IRA/SEP/SIMPLE checkbox beside box 7 is what decides whether the distribution reaches 1040 lines 4a/4b or 5a/5b: the Instructions for Recipient say 'If the IRA/SEP/SIMPLE box is checked, you've received a traditional IRA, SEP, or SIMPLE distribution.' Box 7 code Y (qualified charitable distribution) is NEW for 2025. Box 7 declares its full code table inline, so a route may address 7.G or 7.Y directly as well as test the box7_distribution_code fact.

extraction.note: Azure answers the IRA/SEP/SIMPLE checkbox by MEANING (`IsIraSepSimple`), never by number, and `distribution_is_from_an_ira`'s determination addressed it by that reader name — a second spelling of a box this document already declares, held together by nothing. Declared here so the determination, the mapping row and the reader all name `7-ira-sep-simple` (spec 078). Placement-neutral: neither spelling routes anywhere, the checkbox only ANSWERS the 4a/5a pick. Box 2b is answered as ONE field (`Box2b[0]`) whose VALUE names the ticked checkbox — `totalDistribution` measured on engagement 16 document 118 (box 7 = G), `taxableAmountNotDetermined` the value the 2b flag has always keyed on — so `fields` maps it as a selection onto the two declared 2b checkboxes (spec 080 F-008). Box 7's two-code format and the leaf names of boxes 8-19 are still unmeasured.
